svg.title: A direct route. A slower invitation.
svg.text: UNION PIER / URBAN STUDY / REVISION G / 04
A direct route. A slower invitation.
Movement study / Walking choice and a single service route
Direct / pier public walk
Garden meander
Single upper service route
Geometry checks
4.2 m service lane; approximately 454 m centreline; maximum
sampled centreline grade 2.65%. Four broad crossing locations
connect the two deck levels. Eight limited upper service bays.
All 18 market halls have entrance paths; local branch centreline
grades are below 4.58%.
Feasibility remains conditional
Crossfall, step-free continuity, route legibility, delivery
management and emergency swept paths still require a coordinated
test. Gentle road grades alone do not establish accessible or
fire-safe design.
Rice Mill facade
